summary: Judge 2, iter 005 target_s0: DOES NOT MEET (class CORRECT: no gate fails and every weight-3 L3 passes). I measured base.stl and lid.stl myself with manifold3d/trimesh in the delivered frame, which is already the board frame (board top Z=0; floor underside Z=-8.1; USB end at -X; identity transform). The geometry is a clean two-body tray plus lid: 82.95 x 62.15 x 24.6 mm, 2.4 mm walls/floor/lid, four O5.3 standoffs on a 65 x 45 pitch with O2.10 x 5.0 pilots, four O6 corner bosses outside the walls (pilot O2.50 x 6.0) and lid holes O3.40, lip gap 0.25 and engagement 2.0. USB opening is 10.8 x 7.8 centred on USB_MOUTH (plug clearance 0.40). Jack holes are O8.80 on axes Y 17.667/32.333, Z 2.5 (clearance 0.40). Keep-outs clear by 0.10, the cavity is sealed apart from the ports, and nothing overhangs. Two weight-1 L3s fail. (1) L3.1.6.1: the Pico pins sit 1.13 mm off the catalogue's hole-registered 2.54 grid in X, and the jack pins are unmodelled. Under the current catalogue this is an unsatisfiable conflict with L3.1.3.1 (flush USB mouth), so it needs a decision from Robin or a catalogue change, not only a design change. (2) L3.12.2.1: the agent reports clear_board 0.853 vs measured 1.100 because it used O7 instead of O8 seat columns. Weighted score about 132/134 = 0.985; worst normalised weight-3 margin 0.20 (L3.4.1.1, L3.4.2.1 and L3.5.1.1 at 0.10 over their limits). Observations, not graded: the agent's verification_matrix maps none of its checks to L1.1-L1.12 (every L1 shows 'no check covers this requirement'); there is about 5.7 mm of headroom above the tallest part. claude-context was not used: there was no code search in this judging task and the MCP server failed to connect in this session.
